audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] read "Reflect Twilight Shroud back the moment he commits". Twilight Shroud is a placed smoke zone with no projectile component — there is nothing to reflect.
audit.why: Rebuttal reflects projectiles. Akali's projectile-flagged abilities are Five Point Strike (Q) and Shuriken Flip (E); W is a ground-placed cover of smoke.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the Shuriken Flip mark rule, which is the actual counterplay: the shuriken must hit something to create a mark, and only then can she recast to dash.
sources: champ-data/_kits/akali.json (W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer says that Shuriken Flip's dash is conditional.
audit.why: Riot's text: "The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target." No mark, no dash — and she can mark her own smoke cloud, which is how she disengages.
audit.corrected: Added to winCon, phases[2].why, dosFull[1] and the Key Ability Interactions report row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The range gap that defines the lane is never stated.
audit.why: Radiant Volley casts at 950 and Solar Snare at 1000. Five Point Strike is 550 and Shuriken Flip is 825. Mel outranges Akali's entire non-ultimate kit.
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr, breakdown.early, phases[0].why and tradeGood.

audit.whatIsWrong: Akali's energy economy is never mentioned, so the text has no way to describe when her poke actually stops.
audit.why: Five Point Strike is a flat 1.5-second cooldown but costs 110/100/90/80/70 energy. Her poke rate is limited by energy, not by cooldown, which is why the punish window is the empty bar rather than a timer.
audit.corrected: Added to phases[3].why and content whys[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: "take the fifteen-second invitation" after a wasted Twilight Shroud.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 seconds. Fifteen is below even its rank-5 value.
audit.corrected: Changed to twenty seconds, matching rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: "your only defensive layer is gone for twenty seconds" understates Rebuttal by roughly half.
audit.corrected: Corrected to 38 seconds at rank 1 in tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d, phases[1].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Assassin's Mark is never described, so the player has no tell for the incoming empowered attack.
audit.why: Spell damage on a champion draws a ring; Akali gains the empowered, longer-range attack by EXITING that ring. The ring appearing on you is the countdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr said "Poke mirror you usually win" while diff is HARD at 8/10 and every phase in both layers is marked Akali from level 3 onward.
audit.why: Akali is an assassin with two dashes and an execute, not a poke mage, and the file's own difficulty rating contradicts the tldr. The line also used "his".
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr around the real spacing rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization ends "Add anti-heal early into his sustain." Akali's kit contains no healing at all.
audit.why: akali.json kitFlags has no heal entry on any of the five abilities. Grievous Wounds buys nothing against her base kit.
audit.corrected: Redirected that gold to Zhonya's, which the same line already recommends for dive.

audit.whatIsWrong: content whys[3] says "Shroud resets between trades".
audit.why: Twilight Shroud does not reset; it is a 20/19/18/17/16 second cooldown. At the levels described that is roughly 17-18 seconds.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real cooldown alongside Shuriken Flip's 16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: content wants.you[1] told the player to hold Rebuttal for "her E shuriken and R recast so the projectile-wall eats the engage".
audit.why: Perfect Execution is a dash, not a projectile — calling Rebuttal a projectile wall against it misdescribes what saves her. What Rebuttal actually does to it is prevent the damage.

edits.before: Poke mirror you usually win — your reflect makes his best spell a liability.
edits.after: She is 550 to your 950 — hold the gap and Shuriken Flip finds no mark.

edits.before: Reflect the poke war in your favour and execute the chip. Shorthand: Twilight Shroud down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Deny the Shuriken Flip mark and the all-in never starts. Shorthand: her E missed, wave right, go.

edits.before: Akali wins by landing Twilight Shroud, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Akali wins by landing Shuriken Flip, dashing to the mark, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.

edits.before: Snare through the wave onto his farming spot, fan two full Q volleys while he's locked, and step back with W ready before his answer comes off cooldown.
edits.after: Volley her farming spot from 950 — outside Shuriken Flip's 825 — and if she does flip in, snare the landing and fan the full nine projectiles before the recast lands.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip damage and then standing in Twilight Shroud range — your only defensive layer is gone for twenty seconds.
edits.after: Burning Rebuttal on chip damage and then standing inside Shuriken Flip's 825 range — your only defensive layer is 38 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Akali Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1 — untargetable inside; hold your CC and burst for the moment she exits. - Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1 and must hit something to give her a dash. - Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1, so it is one save per wave.

edits.before: Win the range war from minute one: Q volleys on every last-hit, W held for his one real spell, snare only behind minion cover.
edits.after: Win the spacing war from minute one: Radiant Volley reaches 950, Five Point Strike only 550. Step inside and her slow keeps you there.

edits.before: At 6 the lane becomes an execute countdown — keep stacking, keep him under 60%, and R the moment the math turns lethal. Rotate the snare to river fights.
edits.after: At 6 Perfect Execution is two 675-range leaps on a 120s cooldown at rank 1 — before it lands you are safe at range, after it lands nothing peels.

edits.before: Q volleys win every level-1 range war — fan them across his last-hit positions and stack Overwhelm early.
edits.after: Five Point Strike reaches 550 to your 950 — hold that gap and level 1 is quiet. Step inside and her slow pins you.

edits.before: W Rebuttal online — the reflect turns his poke into your poke. Hold it for his real spell, not for chip.
edits.after: Rebuttal online, but at rank 1 it is 38 seconds — one save per wave. Spend it on her commit, not on chip.

edits.before: Full kit: E snare into full Q volleys is your core chunk. Snare through the wave where he must stand to farm.
edits.after: Shuriken Flip is the lane now: 825 range, 16s at rank 1, and it must hit to mark you. Sidestep and she has no way in.

edits.before: Stack Overwhelm with every hit — once he's marked deep, your execute math starts working. Track Twilight Shroud before stepping up.
edits.after: Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 on a 1.5s cooldown — she is energy-gated, not cooldown-gated. Punish the empty bar.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — anyone you've stacked is now walking around with a countdown. Chip, stack, execute.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is two 675 leaps, 120s at rank 1. Golden Eclipse is global, so stacks banked now still cash later.

edits.before: Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Radiant Volley reaches 950, Five Point Strike only 550 — fan it from outside her step-up range.

edits.before: Reflect Twilight Shroud back the moment he commits
edits.after: Sidestep Shuriken Flip so she has no mark to dash to

edits.before: Akali burns Twilight Shroud on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Akali burns Twilight Shroud on nothing — take the twenty-second invitation.

notes:
Sample size: MC_REAL_GAMES.mel.akali is 15 games, so 33.33% is 5 wins in 15 — directionally consistent with the HARD 8/10 rating but not a measured number.

Unfixable under the fixed-length rule: CHAMP_FULL phases[0].side is "Akali" while MC_CONTENT_EXTRA win[0] is "Mel", and the mechanics favour Mel at level 1 (950 vs 550). Flipping a side is a +/-100% length change, so I rewrote phases[0].why to state the range gap instead.

Left alone for lack of a verifiable source: the repeated claim that Twilight Shroud's untargetability blanks Solar Snare's root and Golden Eclipse's detonation. Whether a global mark-based ultimate and a skillshot root land on a unit inside Shroud is not answerable from Riot's ability text and needsResearch is empty. It may well be correct, but I could not verify it and the guidance says do not speculate, so it stands unedited. Worth a human checking on the League Wiki, because the entire content layer is built on it.
